result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on first-order nonlinear ordinary differential equations of the form $x\,\partial x/\partial y+\alpha x+\beta=y^\mu$ (an Abel-type equation), using the substitution $v=\int x\,dy$, changes of variable and the relation between two solutions $x_1,x_2$.
result.transcription:
$pu - qz + v = x$
$q\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}x = \left(p - \frac{\partial x}{\partial u}\right)x = q\left(m + n(1-u)^{\frac{1}{n}-1}\right)$
$x\frac{\partial x}{\partial y} + \alpha x + \beta = y^\mu$
$\int x\,dy = v$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}^2 + \alpha v + \beta y = \frac{1}{\mu+1}y^{\mu+1}$
$\frac{1}{\mu+1}y^{\mu+1} - \beta y = \alpha z$
$v = wz$
$\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\right)^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)^2 + \alpha v - \alpha z = 0$
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}z + w\right)(w-1)^{-\frac{1}{2}} = f(z)$
$x_1\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial y} + \alpha x_1 + \beta = y^\mu$
$x_2\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial y} + \alpha x_2 + \beta = y^\mu$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}^2 + \alpha v + \beta y = \frac{1}{\mu+1}y^{\mu+1}$
$\alpha v = -\frac{1}{2}p^2 [-+-]-\beta y + \frac{1}{\mu+1}y^{\mu+1}$
$z\frac{\partial (w-1)^{\frac{1}{2}}}{\partial z} + \left(\frac{w^2}{w-1}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} = fz$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}y + \alpha\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}y + \beta y = y^{\mu+1}$
$\alpha\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = \pm\alpha p$
$\pm\frac{1}{2}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial z} + \frac{1}{x} = \alpha f(z)$
$\alpha = 0$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial v_1 + \partial v_2}{\partial y\;\;\partial y} = [-\alpha-]\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log p}$
$\frac{1}{2}x^2 [-+ \alpha z-] + z = 0$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = -\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log p} \pm \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}$
$x = (2(a-z))^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial z} = \frac{\frac{\partial a}{\partial z}}{(a-z)^{\frac{1}{2}}} = \alpha f(z)$
$\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2} = -\alpha [-+-]+ \alpha p\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\right)^2\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial y^2} \pm \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial y^2}$
$= -\alpha + \frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial y^2}\left(+\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log p} \pm \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}\right)$
$\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial y^2}\left(\left(\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log p}\right)^2 - \frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}\right)^2\right) - \beta + y^\mu = 0$
$x_1\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial x_2}\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial y} + \alpha x_1 + \beta = y^\mu.$
$x_2\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial y} + \alpha x_2 + \beta = y^\mu$
$(y^\mu - \beta)\left(x_1\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial x_2} - x_2\right) = \alpha x_1 x_2\left(\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial x_2} - 1\right)$
$\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial y}\left(x_1\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial x_2} - x_2\right) = \alpha(x_2 - x_1)$

methods.what: First-order nonlinear ODE (Abel type) under study
Integration via $v=\int x\,dy$ giving a first integral relation
Change of independent variable $z$ and substitution $v=wz$
Transformed equation and the special case $\alpha=0$ solved explicitly
Expression of $\partial v/\partial y$ in terms of $p$ and resulting second-order relation
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial y^2}\left(\left(\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log p}\right)^2 - \frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}\right)^2\right) - \beta + y^\mu = 0$
$\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial y}\left(x_1\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial x_2} - x_2\right) = \alpha(x_2 - x_1)$
